---
title: "QC of Eucalyptus x phylacis ONT Reads"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_qc                   <- file.path(currentdir, "01_qc")
outdir_qc_chopper           <- file.path(outdir_qc,  "01_chopper")
outdir_qc_nanoplot_raw      <- file.path(outdir_qc,  "nanoplot_raw")
outdir_qc_nanoplot_filtered <- file.path(outdir_qc,  "nanoplot_filtered")
outdir_qc_genomescope       <- file.path(outdir_qc,  "02_genomescope")

sapply(c(outdir_qc_chopper, outdir_qc_nanoplot_raw, outdir_qc_nanoplot_filtered, outdir_qc_genomescope), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# output files
fn_filtered_fastqgz <- file.path(outdir_qc_chopper, "filtered.fastq.gz")

# check if input directory is empty
ls_raw_fastqgz <- list.files(params$dir_raw_fastqgz, pattern="*\\.fastq.gz$", recursive=F, full.names=F)
if (length(ls_raw_fastqgz) < 1) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Input dir_raw_fastqgz is empty. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## Chopper

```{r chopper, include=F}
# run NanoPlot pre-filtering
f_nanoplot(fn_fastq     = file.path(params$dir_raw_fastqgz, "*.fastq.gz"),
           dir_out      = outdir_qc_nanoplot_raw,
           thread       = params$thread,
           title        = "E_phylacis_Raw_ONT",
           exe_nanoplot = params$exe_nanoplot) 

# run Chopper
if (!file.exists(fn_filtered_fastqgz) || params$redo) {
    f_chopper(fn_fastq          = file.path(params$dir_raw_fastqgz, "*.fastq.gz"),
              min_q             = 10,
              min_len           = 15000,
              fn_fastq_filtered = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
              thread            = params$thread,
              exe_pigz          = params$exe_pigz,
              exe_chopper       = params$exe_chopper,
              exe_bgzip         = params$exe_bgzip)
}

# run NanoPlot post-filtering
f_nanoplot(fn_fastq     = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
           dir_out      = outdir_qc_nanoplot_filtered,
           thread       = params$thread,
           title        = "E_phylacis_Filtered_ONT",
           exe_nanoplot = params$exe_nanoplot)

# create a comparison table for the NanoPlot results
df_nanoplot_raw      <- f_parse_nanostats(file.path(outdir_qc_nanoplot_raw,      "NanoStats.txt"))
df_nanoplot_filtered <- f_parse_nanostats(file.path(outdir_qc_nanoplot_filtered, "NanoStats.txt"))

# convert the table to be more readable
df_nanoplot_all   <- as.data.frame(t(rbind(df_nanoplot_raw, df_nanoplot_filtered)))
df_nanoplot_stats <- df_nanoplot_all %>%
                        mutate(metrics = rownames(df_nanoplot_all), raw = V1, filtered = V2) %>%
                        select(metrics, raw, filtered) %>%
                        filter(!grepl("^q", metrics))

# extract the percentage of reads per quality score
pattern <- c(reads = "\\d+", "\\s+\\(", pct = "[0-9.]+", "%\\)\\s+", mb = "[0-9.]+", "Mb")

df_nanoplot_q     <- df_nanoplot_all %>%
                        mutate(metrics = rownames(df_nanoplot_all), raw = V1, filtered = V2) %>%
                        select(metrics, raw, filtered) %>%
                        filter(grepl("^q", metrics)) %>%
                        separate_wider_regex(raw,      pattern, names_sep = "_") %>%
                        separate_wider_regex(filtered, pattern, names_sep = "_") %>%
                        mutate(across(-metrics, as.numeric))

# save the output tables
data.table::fwrite(df_nanoplot_stats, file=file.path(outdir_qc_chopper, "summary_nanoplot_stats.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F)
data.table::fwrite(df_nanoplot_q,     file=file.path(outdir_qc_chopper, "summary_nanoplot_q.tsv"),     sep="\t", quote=F)
```

## GenomeScope2

```{r genomescope, include=F}
# run GenomeScope2
f_kmc_genomescope(fn_fastq        = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
                  kmer            = 21,
                  dir_out         = outdir_qc_genomescope,
                  thread          = params$thread,
                  exe_kmc         = params$exe_kmc,
                  exe_kmctools    = params$exe_kmctools,
                  exe_genomescope = params$exe_genomescope)
```

## Kraken2

```{r kraken, eval=params$run_kraken2, include=params$run_kraken2}
# check if database exists
if (!dir.exists(params$dir_kraken2_db)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Input dir_kraken2_db is not found. Skipped.")

} else {
    outdir_qc_kraken <- file.path(outdir_qc, "03_kraken")
    if (!dir.exists(outdir_qc_kraken)) {
        dir.create(outdir_qc_kraken, recursive=T)
    }

    f_kraken2(fn_fastq    = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
              dir_db      = params$dir_kraken2_db,
              confidence  = 0.2,
              dir_out     = outdir_qc_kraken,
              thread      = params$thread,
              exe_kraken2 = params$exe_kraken2)
}
```
